counterfactual_missing_items: Culture, Grocott staining, and cytology were negative
decisive_items: Diffuse ground-glass opacity, mosaic attenuation, and ill-defined centrilobular nodules
Krebs von den Lungen-6 level: 1250 U/mL
response.rationale: R5 is best supported by the raw temporal link between TC chemotherapy and recurrent diffuse ground-glass opacities with centrilobular nodules, elevated KL-6, and BAL lymphocytosis. R3 shares imaging features but is weakened by negative anti-T. asahii antibodies and no exposure history. R2 describes a pattern rather than the drug-related etiology. R1 lacks any radiation therapy mention, and R7 has no raw imaging support.

rejected.why: Organizing pneumonia is a plausible pattern but does not explain the chemotherapy-related recurrent timing as directly as drug-induced pneumonitis.
Hypersensitivity pneumonitis is possible given mosaic attenuation and BAL lymphocytosis, but negative anti-T. asahii antibodies and absence of an exposure history reduce its support.
Radiation pneumonitis is unsupported because no radiation therapy is mentioned; only chemotherapy and ground-glass opacity are present.
Lymphocytic interstitial pneumonia has no raw support spans and relies only on BAL lymphocytosis, which is nonspecific.
